summary: A melee swing's active region: disabled until you activate it, and hits each target once per swing.
overview: The hit region of a melee attack. Its collider stays DISABLED until Activate — the active-frames window of a swing — so it cannot hit outside the animation's intended timing. It also hits each Hurtbox at most once per activation, so one swing cannot multi-hit the same target.
useCases: A sword, claw or punch with real active frames.
A weapon whose hit window is driven by an animation event.
Any attack that should connect once per swing rather than per frame of overlap.

params.tuning: Who counts as the attacker, for friendly fire and kill attribution. Defaults to this object, which is wrong when the hitbox is on a weapon held by a character.
Applied away from the hitbox, so where you place it changes the direction of the push.

gotchas.title: It is inactive until something calls Activate
gotchas.body: A hitbox that never hits anything is usually one nobody activated. MeleeAttack is what normally drives that window.

gotchas.title: The once-per-swing guard resets on Activate, not on time
gotchas.body: A long active window still only hits each target once. Two hits need two activations.
